headline: Air Products Reports Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Results
summary: Air Products (NYSE:APD) today reported third quarter fiscal 2026 GAAP results, including operating loss of $2.1 billion and loss per share# of $6.47, each down over 300 percent, and GAAP operating margin of negative 66.3 percent, compared to 26.2 percent in the prior year. Fiscal 2026 results include charges of approximately $2.9 billion pre-tax ($2.2 billion after-tax, or $9.92 per share) associated with project exit decisions announced on June 30, 2026.
